description: This file contains unit tests for the InMemoryCache class in the litellm.caching.in_memory_cache module. It tests cache set/get operations, size and TTL constraints, expiration handling, eviction policies, and heap management, using pytest and mock objects.

classes.name: InMemoryCache
classes.description: The InMemoryCache class implements an in-memory cache with TTL, size constraints, and eviction policies, used to store key-value pairs for efficient retrieval during tests.

methods.name: test_in_memory_openai_obj_cache()
methods.description: Tests that objects set in the cache with a specific key can be retrieved correctly, verifying the set and get cache methods.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_max_size_per_item()
methods.description: Ensures that the cache rejects items larger than the maximum allowed size per item.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_ttl()
methods.description: Checks that TTL is assigned correctly, and items expire as expected, with TTL being removed upon expiration.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_ttl_allow_override()
methods.description: Verifies the correct behavior of TTL override and expiration logic.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_max_size_with_ttl()
methods.description: Confirms that the maximum size of the cache is respected even when all items have long TTLs, evicting oldest entries when capacity is exceeded.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_expired_items_evicted_first()
methods.description: Ensures expired items are evicted before non-expired when cache reaches maximum capacity.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_eviction_order()
methods.description: Verifies that eviction order respects expiration times, removing items with earliest expiration first when needed.

methods.name: test_in_memory_cache_heap_size_staus_bounded()
methods.description: Tests that the expiration heap remains bounded and does not grow unboundedly despite repeated cache updates.
